title: Dragons Eat People
description: A human flesh food mod for Dragon Survival
body:
Adds human flesh for Dragon Survival dragons to eat. That's it. It's cursed.

Raw Human will drop from human players, as well as villagers/illagers/wandering traders. It can be cooked into Cooked Human.

If a human eats it, it will most likely (90% chance) inflict hunger and nausea. Because we draw the line at caniballism in this human flesh mod apparently. Dragons eat humans. Humans do not eat humans.

By default, it fits the forest dragon's diet since that's the one that eats raw meat. It's covered under #c:food/raw_meat and #c:foods/cooked_meat, but if you'd like to add this specifically to any diets just add humanfleshds:raw_human and/or humanflesh:cooked_human
